Air zone, open between the ribs, for insulation

Cast concrete cut by the plane (crossed hatch): the

and stirrups as in the rib section).

Notes
Heights are levels from the ground floor (eave +2.50,
crown +8.50). Large slice at +6.00 (3500 above the eave),
1:50, just below the middle horizontal rib of option A
Option A: all 11 columns per face at +4.00 and +6.00; at
+7.50 every other column has stopped (they stop once the
spacing is 500); above +7.77 only the four hip ribs go on
to the top ring at the crown (+8.50), where the cut is
only the ring. Middle horizontal ribs at +4.31, +6.13 and
Layer 2 thins towards the crown (the leaf is 160 at the
base, 80 at the crown). Ribs use the same geometry as the
roof-grid sheets; bars and stirrups are assumed.
